useCases.title: Schedule an inspection against an Approved booking
mainFlow: An inspector schedules an inspection against an Approved booking and the agent is notified of the time slot.

useCases.title: Dangerous goods require inspection before approval
mainFlow: A booking with cargo class Dangerous Goods cannot be Approved until an inspection has been scheduled.

useCases.title: Inspection checklist categories
mainFlow: An inspection consists of checklist items in the categories Safety, Environmental, Documentation and Security.

useCases.title: Record checklist item outcome
mainFlow: For each checklist item the inspector records compliant or not compliant, a severity of Low, Medium or High, and an optional note.

useCases.title: Inspection Failed on any High-severity non-compliance
mainFlow: An inspection whose checklist contains any non-compliant item of High severity has the outcome Failed.

useCases.title: Failed inspection blocks departure until follow-up Passed
mainFlow: A Failed inspection blocks departure clearance until a follow-up inspection has Passed.

useCases.title: Berth Officer surcharge relief for short vessels (PARTIAL CONTRADICTION — see OQ-3)
mainFlow: A berth officer may waive the late-arrival surcharge for vessels shorter than 80 metres.
useCases.notes: Contradicts 13-berth-allocation-rules.md#L40 ('Only the Harbour Master may waive a tariff surcharge'). See openQuestions OQ-3.

useCases.title: Departure clearance requires every inspection Passed or Deferred
mainFlow: Departure clearance is granted by a Berth Officer and requires every inspection on the booking to be Passed or Deferred.

openQuestions.question: Surcharge waiver authority: 'only the Harbour Master' (13 §9.3) vs 'a berth officer may waive the late-arrival surcharge for vessels <80m' (24 §20.3). Which governs?
openQuestions.assumption: The specific rule (ch24) is a scoped exception to the general one (ch13): Berth Officers may waive only the late-arrival surcharge, only for vessels under 80 metres; every other surcharge still requires the Harbour Master.
